name: Multi-step Form
hint: Press Continue with empty fields to see validation. Finished steps are clickable.
description: A flow of steps built from TextField, ChoiceCards and Button: a progress rail you can jump back along, direction-aware step slides, per-step validation that shakes what needs attention, and an optional review step. Steps, fields, values and the submit are yours.
usage: Use for a flow that is too long for one screen (signup, onboarding, checkout details), one decision per step. Pass `steps`: each { id, name, title, description, fields, content, validate, optional, review }. A field is { name, label, type ("text", "email", "url", "tel", "password", "number" or "choice" with `options`), required, validate ("required" | "email" | "url" | "none" | (value, values) => message), hint, icon, autoComplete, inputMode, defaultValue }. For anything else put your own markup in `content` and check it in the step's `validate(values)` (return a message or { field: message }). Continue checks the step; a failing step shakes its fields and focuses the first. Hold the values with `values` / `onValuesChange` (that is also your draft hook) or seed `defaultValues`; drive the step with `step` / `onStepChange`. A step with `review: true` lists every earlier field with Edit links. On the last step `onSubmit(values, event)` fires; set `loading` while you send, `submitError` if it failed, and `complete` once it worked (title and text from `completeTitle` / `completeDescription`). Nothing is sent and no success is shown on its own. `optional: true` adds a Skip button to that step.

dataProps.description: The steps, in order: { id, name (rail label), title, description?, fields?, content?, validate?(values), optional?, review?, reviewRows?(values) }. fields: { name, label, type, required?, validate?, hint?, icon?, placeholder?, autoComplete?, inputMode?, maxLength?, defaultValue?, options? (choice), columns?, multiple?, reviewLabel?, format?(value, values), review? }. content: a node, or ({ values, setValue, errors, reveal, step, goTo }) => node. No steps renders nothing.
Controlled values, keyed by field name. Pass with onValuesChange.
Starting values when uncontrolled (merged over each field's defaultValue).
(values, { name, value }) => void on every edit: keep a draft, preview, or control the form.
Controlled current step (0-based). Pass with onStepChange.
Starting step when uncontrolled (startStep is the older name and still works).
(index, { id, from, via }) => void when Continue, Back, Skip, the rail, an Edit link or a failed submit wants another step; via is "next" | "back" | "skip" | "rail" | "edit" | "submit" | "content".
(values, event) => void when the last step's button is pressed (or Enter there) and every step passes its checks. Send the values yourself; the form submits nothing on its own.
You are sending: the submit button shows its spinner and the form will not submit, go back or skip until you clear it.
Why the submit failed (from your server), shown above the buttons on the last step until you clear it.
Set true once your submit worked: the form is replaced by the finish panel. Leave undefined and it never shows on its own.
Finish panel text, or (values) => node. Empty shows none.
Text of the last step's button.
Field error copy, merged over TextField's neutral defaults: { required, emailRequired, email, urlRequired, url }.

Words, merged over neutral defaults: { back: "Back", next: "Continue", skip: "Skip", edit: "Edit", editAria: (label) => string, notSet: "Not set", progress: "Progress", kicker: (i, n) => string, stepAria: (i, name, state) => string, completeTitle: "Done" }.
Every field and button inert, the rail included.
